mapper.select: SELECT tss.id, tss.main_id, ty.year, tss.shop_id, tss.shop_name, tss.month, tss.value, tss.metrics FROM bi_target_shop_setting tss LEFT JOIN bi_target_year ty ON tss.main_id=ty.id and ty.is_deleted=false WHERE tss.is_deleted=false AND ty.year=#{year}
